cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(JTBass VERSION 1.0.0)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
include(cmake/CPM.cmake)
CPMAddPackage("gh:juce-framework/JUCE#8.0.6")
juce_add_plugin(JTBass COMPANY_NAME "JT" PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Jtco PLUGIN_CODE JtBs FORMATS VST3 PRODUCT_NAME "JT Bass")
target_sources(JTBass PRIVATE Source/PluginProcessor.cpp Source/PluginEditor.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(JTBass PRIVATE JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0 JUCE_USE_CURL=0 JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0)
target_link_libraries(JTBass PRIVATE juce::juce_audio_utils juce::juce_dsp)
